name: HRTS 4291
title: Service Learning Seminar/Internship
description: Combination of supervised fieldwork within the larger human rights community with regular classroom meetings for reflection/analysis on the application of human rights concepts and practices. Students must secure a satisfactory intern position before the end of the second week of the semester of enrollment in this course; students should be in consultation with the instructor several months in advance. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: Instructor consent; nine credits of 2000-level or above HRTS courses (six of which may be taken concurrently).
